infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Circuit Timer records your position on track during an active session to time your laps and sectors. Location is only used while a session is running and never in the background.

NSLocationTemporaryUsageDescriptionDicti.TrackSession: Circuit Timer needs precise location during this track session to time your laps and sectors accurately; approximate location isn't accurate enough for lap timing.
